checklist: Fast scrolling in Cull on a real card, largest tiles: frame pacing (p95 ≤ 17.5 ms), share of on-screen tiles still blank or fading while scrolling, and thumbnail sharpness (thumbnail pixels per displayed device pixel, want ≥ 1). Evidence: scroll-* frames, tiles-*.json, thumbs.json, mid-scroll snapshots.

steps.src: const L = __probe.logic(), el = L.scrollRef.current, S = window.__scrollStats = { blanks: [], ups: [] }; const shown = im => im.complete && im.naturalWidth > 0 && +getComputedStyle(im).opacity > 0.99; const f = () => { if (!window.__scrollStats) return; const vr = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const t = [...el.querySelectorAll('[data-tile] img')].filter(im => { const r = im.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.bottom > vr.top && r.top < vr.bottom; }); if (t.length) { S.blanks.push(t.filter(im => !shown(im)).length / t.length); t.filter(im => im.naturalWidth).forEach(im => S.ups.push(im.naturalWidth / (im.clientWidth * devicePixelRatio))); } requestAnimationFrame(f); }; requestAnimationFrame(f); return true;

steps.name: tiles-glide
steps.js: const S = window.__scrollStats; window.__scrollStats = null; const b = S.blanks.slice().sort((a, c) => a - c), u = S.ups.slice().sort((a, c) => a - c); const p = (a, q) => a.length ? a[Math.min(a.length - 1, Math.floor(q * a.length))] : null; return { frames: b.length, blankMeanPct: +(100 * b.reduce((a, c) => a + c, 0) / Math.max(1, b.length)).toFixed(1), blankP95Pct: +(100 * (p(b, 0.95) || 0)).toFixed(1), upscaleMin: u.length ? +u[0].toFixed(2) : null, upscaleMedian: u.length ? +p(u, 0.5).toFixed(2) : null, dpr: devicePixelRatio };

steps.name: thumbs
steps.js: const l = __probe.logic(); return Promise.all(l.real.slice(0, 40).map(p => fetch(p.src).then(r => r.blob()).then(b => b.size))).then(s => ({ photos: l.real.length, readSecs: (l.state.realInfo || {}).secs, thumbKB: +(s.reduce((a, c) => a + c, 0) / s.length / 1024).toFixed(1) }))
